{{Quote|Divo kept a growing folder of incident reports involving a low-level con man named Dannl Faytonni, known to prowl the entertainment establishments of the Uscru District, particularly levels in the 4000s to mid-3000s range.|Exantor Divo, ''Scum and Villainy: Case Files on the Galaxy's Most Notorious''|<ref name="Scum and Villainy Case Files" />}}
'''Dannl Faytonni''' was a [[Gender|male]] [[human]] and a known associate of [[Achk Med-Beq]]. The two were present in the [[Outlander Club]] on [[Coruscant]] in [[22 BBY]] when the [[Clawdite]] [[assassin]] [[Zam Wesell]] [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala|attempted]] to hide there to escape the pursuing [[Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker]]. By the [[time]] Wesell, Kenobi, and Skywalker got to the back of the establishment, Faytonni and Med-Beq were patrolling the second floor of the Outlander. [[19 BBY|Three years later]], Faytonni attended the [[Galaxies Opera House]] the same night Skywalker met with [[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]].

==Biography==
===Police impersonator===
{{Quote|Though Faytonni's greatest transgression was the impersonation of an officer of the Republic Judiciary, which triggered the issuing of a warrant for his arrest. Ultimately, it was not deemed a priority assignment as greater emphasis was placed on homeworld security in the wake of the Clone Wars.|Exantor Divo, ''Scum and Villainy: Case Files on the Galaxy's Most Notorious''|<ref name="Scum and Villainy Case Files" />}}
[[File:Dannl_Faytonni_SaV.png|thumb|left|250px|Dannl Faytonni worked as a con artist.]]
Born in around [[76 BBY]]<ref name="Date" /> on the [[planet]] [[Corellia]],<ref name="Helmet Collection 39" /> Dannl Faytonni was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] who worked as a low-level [[Con artist|con man]] on the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]], where he frequented entertainment establishments in the [[Uscru District]] most commonly between levels of [[Imperial City|Galactic City]] in the mid-3000s and 4000s range.<ref name="Scum and Villainy Case Files" /> The [[Corellian]] worked in partnership with fellow con man [[Achk Med-Beq]] and, after escaping from [[prison]] together, the pair procured a set of [[Republic Security Force]] [[Clothing|uniforms]]<ref name="Helmet Collection 39" /> in order to impersonate [[Judicial|member]] of the [[Judicial Department|Republic Judiciary]]<ref name="Scum and Villainy Case Files" /> in [[22 BBY]].<ref name="AOTCDate">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates the events of {{Film|II}} to [[22 BBY]].</ref>

While in their newly acquired uniforms, the pair visited the [[Outlander Club]] in the [[Uscru Entertainment District]] while looking for easy marks. Splitting up, Faytonni ended up lent on the bar while conversing with three human women, one of whom left just as the [[Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] was served a drink next to them. The trio continued talking until Kenobi suddenly drew his [[Obi-Wan Kenobi's second lightsaber|lightsaber]] and sliced off the [[Limb|arm]] of the [[bounty hunter]] [[Zam Wesell]], who had been discreetly moving up behind the [[Jedi]] with a [[KYD-21 blaster pistol|blaster pistol]] drawn. Faytonni spun round in surprise, but soon turned back to his conversation as Kenobi escorted Wesell out of the club. He turned again to listen as Kenobi's [[Padawan]], [[Anakin Skywalker]], announced that what the patrons had witnessed was Jedi business, telling them to go back to their drinks.<ref name="AOTC" /> As the Jedi questioned Wesell in an alley outside the club, Faytonni and Med-Beq reunited and plotted together while waling along the club's upper balcony level.<ref name="CL 2016">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2016)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref>

===Continued activity===
{{Quote|I hate having to compromise in this way, but it's hard to argue that Faytonni is worth the fuel cells required to send a speeder down to fetch him, and he has a talent for washing his hands of crime. But he'll mess up. They always do.|Inspector Tan Divo|<ref name="Scum and Villainy Case Files" />}}
The fifty-four [[Standard year|year]] old Faytonni's impersonation of a Judical proved to be his greatest transgression, and an warrant was issued for his arrest at the [[Level 3921]] [[Leve 3921 issuing office|issuing office]]. Although the warrant was processed, it was ultimately not deemed to be a priority assignment due to the [[First Battle of Geonosis|outbreak]] of the [[Clone Wars]] shortly after, which shifted the Security Force's priority to [[homeworld]] security. Nevertheless, [[Inspector]] [[Tanivos Exantor Divo|Tanivos Divo]] of the Coruscant Security Force, who had kept a folder of incident reports on Faytonni, continued to keep a remote [[eye]] on the con man and encouraged [[Police officer|beat officers]] in the Uscru District to do the same. While under this surveillance, Faytonni adapted by beginning to offer up usable leads and fragmented information on larger targets to the Security Force in exchange for them mostly turning a blind eye to his illegal racket.<ref name="Scum and Villainy Case Files" />

Divo accepted the situation with reservations, writing in his notes that although he hated such a compromise, he found it hard to argue that Faytonni was even worth the [[fuel]] cells it would take to send a [[speeder]] to bring him in. He also added a [[Hologram|holo]] of Faytonni selling two [[spice]]d [[death stick]]s on the sly to an [[alien]] patron of the Outlander Club.<ref name="Scum and Villainy Case Files" /> In [[19 BBY]],<ref name="ROTSDate">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates the events of {{Film|III}} to [[19 BBY]].</ref> Faytonni was still working as a con artist and wore fake military gear while attending the [[Galaxies Opera House]]<ref name="CVD">''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary, New Edition]]''</ref> in the higher levels of the Uscru District.<ref name="CL 2016" /> The Corellian walked up the opera house's steps alongside another uniformed human as Skywalker—who by that time was a [[Jedi Knight]]<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref> and [[Hero With No Fear|war hero]]<ref name="CVD" />—ran past them while on his way to meet [[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]] inside.<ref name="ROTS" />

===Legacy===
{{Quote|Nonetheless, Divo kept a remote eye on Faytonni, and encouraged the beat cops of Uscru to do likewise.|Exantor Divo, ''Scum and Villainy: Case Files on the Galaxy's Most Notorious''|<ref name="Scum and Villainy Case Files" />}}
During the [[New Republic Era]], [[New Republic]] [[Law enforcement agency|police]] [[commissioner]] [[Exantor Divo]], grandson of Tanivos Divo, wrote about Faytonni in his [[book]], ''[[Scum and Villainy: Case Files on the Galaxy's Most Notorious]]'',<ref name="Scum and Villainy Case Files" /> which was published in [[34 ABY]]<ref name="PublishDate">{{ScumAndVillainyDate}}</ref> and detailed the experiences of three generations of law enforcement officials in his [[Divo family|family]]. He included information from his grandfather's casefile on the con man, including his arrest warrant and the holo of him dealing death sticks.<ref name="Scum and Villainy Case Files" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|The ever-adaptive Faytonni found his niche while under such surveillance, offering up usable leads and fragmented information on larger quarry to the law in exchange for being able to continue his racket relatively unmolested.|Exantor Divo, ''Scum and Villainy: Case Files on the Galaxy's Most Notorious''|<ref name="Scum and Villainy Case Files" />}}
Dannl Faytonni was a constantly adaptive individual, and found his niche in providing information to other criminals to law enforcement in exchange for his own continued freedom.<ref name="Scum and Villainy Case Files" /> He had [[Color|gray]] [[hair]], blue [[eye]]s, and light skin.<ref name="AOTC" />

==Equipment==
The stolen uniform that Faytonni wore at the Outlander Club was blue with golden markings on the sleeves and also included black [[boot]]s and a black [[belt]] and braces.<ref name="Helmet Collection 39" /> In the image used on his arrest warrant, he wore a white shirt under a black jacket.<ref name="Scum and Villainy Case Files" /> The fake military gear he wore to the opera house was once again blue with gold markings on the sleeves, but this time also included further gold embellishments on the shoulders and neck, as well as a tall blue hat with a logo on the front and gold markings on the sides.<ref name="CVD" />

==Behind the scenes==
Dannl Faytonni first appeared in the [[2002]] film [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']] and was portrayed by ''[[Star Wars]]'' veteran [[Anthony Daniels]], the actor who also played [[C-3PO]].<ref name="AOTC" /> In the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], Faytonni was identified in the [[2016]] reference book [[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2016)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']].<ref name="CL 2016" /> Daniels' cameo as Faytonni is notable for being the first time the actor had appeared in a ''Star Wars'' film without the C-3PO costume covering his body,<ref name="Official Collector's Edition">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars – The Official Collector's Edition|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' – The Official Collector's Edition]]</ref> which would later be followed by his cameo as<ref name="Solo">''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''</ref> the [[Coruscanti]] con artist [[Tak]]<ref name="Ultimate Star Wars NE">''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]''</ref> during a [[Raid on Kessel|slave uprising]] in the [[spice mines of Kessel]] in the [[2018]] film ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''.<ref name="Solo" />
